finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker could input a value that triggers a command execution in the validateCell function.
finding.assumptions: The validateCell function or any function it calls might execute a command based on the input.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the board array is not properly initialized or if an attacker can control the contents of the board array, this could lead to a buffer overflow.
finding.assumptions: The board array is expected to have exactly 9 elements, but there is no explicit check to ensure this.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker could influence the random number generator to trigger a command execution in the validateCell function.
finding.assumptions: The validateCell function or any function it calls might execute a command based on the input.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the player.symbol is attacker-controlled and contains a command, this could lead to command execution.
finding.assumptions: The player.symbol is expected to be either 'X' or 'O', but there is no explicit check to ensure this.
